_about: Public-domain F. D. Maurice (Frederick Denison Maurice, 1805-1872, Anglican theologian, Christian Socialist, Knightbridge Professor at Cambridge) for the Word Hoard: The Gospel of St. John (new edition, 1882) from Project Gutenberg, and 28 more from Internet Archive scans, 1839-1873, among them The Kingdom of Christ (1842), Theological Essays (1853), The Doctrine of Sacrifice (1854), What is Revelation? (1859) and Social Morality (1869). His histories of philosophy are left to the philosophy lane. Raw OCR. Added 2026-10-17 by lane A, round 23 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.
